programme.title: WW2 Chronicles
programme.desc: After the defeat of Nazi Germany, leading figures of the Third Reich face an international tribunal in Nuremberg. The proceedings examine evidence of aggressive war, mass atrocities, the blockade of Leningrad and the planned destruction of civilians in occupied territories. Witness testimony and official documents reveal the scale of the crimes and the difficult debate over how the perpetrators should be judged. The verdicts help shape the modern principles of international law and reaffirm that fascism must be condemned

programme.title: American Story
programme.desc: Behind Hawaii’s image of beaches and carefree living lies the story of a kingdom overthrown in 1893. The loss of land, identity and political independence continues to affect Native Hawaiians, while historians question the legality of the islands’ annexation. Communities are reviving ancestral language, traditions and cultural practices as they seek to preserve their heritage and assert that Hawaiian sovereignty was never surrendered

programme.title: Historical files
programme.desc: Delve into the compelling historical narrative surrounding Patrice Lumumba, an iconic figure of African independence, and the establishment of the Peoples' Friendship University in Moscow. Through meticulously researched archival records, rare footage, and firsthand testimonies, this in-depth exploration sheds light on the geopolitical shifts of the Cold War era. Discover how a visionary initiative aimed at empowering youth from developing nations shaped international diplomacy, fostered cross-cultural connections, and created a lasting legacy that continues to influence modern global relations

programme.title: American Story
programme.desc: Behind Hawaii’s image of beaches and carefree living lies the story of a kingdom overthrown in 1893. The loss of land, identity and political independence continues to affect Native Hawaiians, while historians question the legality of the islands’ annexation. Communities are reviving ancestral language, traditions and cultural practices as they seek to preserve their heritage and assert that Hawaiian sovereignty was never surrendered

programme.title: WW2 Chronicles
programme.desc: After the defeat of Nazi Germany, leading figures of the Third Reich face an international tribunal in Nuremberg. The proceedings examine evidence of aggressive war, mass atrocities, the blockade of Leningrad and the planned destruction of civilians in occupied territories. Witness testimony and official documents reveal the scale of the crimes and the difficult debate over how the perpetrators should be judged. The verdicts help shape the modern principles of international law and reaffirm that fascism must be condemned

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Burnley v Blackburn RoversBurnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: An Innocent Man
programme.desc: 1989. Crime Drama. Directed by Peter Yates. Stars Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham And Laila Robins. Two corrupt cops send an innocent man to prison, leading him to seek revenge on his release. [S]

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Play of the Month: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: 1974. Drama. Director: James MacTaggart. Stars Stanley Baker, Ram John Holder And Jerome Willis. A man struggles to survive after being shipwrecked on a deserted island. [S]

programme.title: Three Silent Men
programme.desc: 1940. Crime. An inventor of a deadly weapon to be used against the allies is injured in a crash. Surgeon, Sir James (Sebastian Shaw) saves his life but learns of his plot. Stars Derrick De Marney. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Hero. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Bill Owen And John Dearth. After the sheriff's brother is killed, the man responsible is taken in by Robin, but tensions soon rise as he struggles to fit in. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Lost City. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell And Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Rattan Trunk. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Peter Grant And Jan Holden. Bert Edwards receives a trunk full of Persian rugs. Soon after the luggage turns up at Euston Station with a body inside. [S]

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: Conspiracy Of Silence. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West. [S]

programme.title: The Great Van Robbery
programme.desc: 1959. Crime Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Denis Shaw, Kay Callard And Tony Quinn. An Interpol detective pursues a dangerous thief who has placed his loot into a bank account in Rio de Janeiro. [S]

programme.title: Morocco
programme.desc: 1930. Romance. Director: Josef von Sternberg. Stars Gary Cooper, Marlene Dietrich And Adolphe Menjou. A night club singer and a Legionnaire fall in love, but their relationship becomes complicated. [S]

programme.title: Salvage with a Smile 1940
programme.desc: 1940. Second World War comedy short explaining the value of salvage with Kathleen Harrison and Ronald Shiner, made at Ealing Studios.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Guns. 1976. Stars Ray Lonnen, Albert Welling And John Cording. Armed robbery is becoming almost a daily event and soon someone will get hurt. What happens if the police meet violence with violence? [S]

programme.title: Della
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Gist and starring Joan Crawford. Della (Crawford), a reclusive matriarch of Royal Bay, watches over the affluent coastal town. Possession, for her, is everything. [S]

programme.title: Banking a Banana
programme.desc: 1961. A previously lost comedy short, starring Spike Milligan, about using bananas as a form of currency.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Man Who Sold Pardons. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Nigel Green And Robin Hunter. A charlatan posing as a monk is going through towns selling indulgences, bearing a forged document from the king! [S]

programme.title: Send For Paul Temple
programme.desc: 1946. Crime Drama. Directed by John Argyle. Starring Anthony Hulme and Joy Shelton. Scotland Yard calls in novelist and amateur detective Paul Temple to help track down a gang of diamond robbers. [S]

programme.title: Film Noir
programme.desc: Origins of Noir. 2022. The origins of Film Noir begin with the industrial revolution and with the ideas that that form of mechanised production produces. [S]

programme.title: Blithe Spirit
programme.desc: 1945. Comedy. Director: David Lean. Stars Rex Harrison, Constance Cummings, Kay Hammond, Margaret Rutherford. A newly-married writer and his second wife are haunted by the ghost of his first wife. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life A Flight of Fancy
programme.desc: 1961. How does a homing pigeon 'home'? This film takes a look at the development of the birds, from fledglings to long-distance champions.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1965. The Material Witness. Stars Edgar Lustgarten And John Carlin. A young executive plots to replace a firm's manager, and turns him in to police as a drunk driver. [S] (S1, E09)

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike and Noel step back to 1947 with warnings for curious children, then it's off to Sweden for a little nostalgia from 1957 and the detectives talk fireworks 50s style and explosive escapades. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Maigret Versus Mr Cavre. 1997. Stars Bruno Cremer, Nade Dieu And Jacques Boudet. Maigret travels to a small town in Belgium to help a friend whose brother-in-law has been accused of murder. [S]

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Christopher Biggins, Lindy Benson. Plumber's mate Sid meets ladies at work. Susie is unaware of his dalliances as he gets into debt trouble. [S]

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Martinique - Meurtres en Martinique. 2016. Director: Philippe Niang. Stars Sara Martins And Olivier Marchal. Parisian forensic specialist helps in an investigation near Mount Pelée. [S]

programme.title: Birmingham And The Road Patrol Bikes
programme.desc: Glimpses: 1950s. We start in Birmingham at the famous BSA factory where we follow the annual Road Patrol. Marvel at their side chassis and box carriers and follow them to Exeter, Abroath And Belfast.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Muddy Kasoff Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Nita Talbot, Robert Karnes. Barney Ruditsky investigates the murder of Muddy Kasoff, using minimal clues to track down the gangsters responsible.

programme.title: Mrs Mike
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Director: Louis King. Stars Dick Powell, Evelyn Keyes And J.M Kerrigan. Kathy O'Fallon meets Mountie Mike Flannigan. They fall in love, but can their love survive? [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: The Book
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars David Niven, Marguerite Chapman And Douglas Fowley. An author's curiosity about a piece of paper found in a library book leads him to a group of spies. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Glorious Mud
programme.desc: 1960. An entertaining look at the role mud plays in all of our lives.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Marsha, Queen of Diamonds. 1966. Stars Adam West, Carolyn Jones And Estelle Winwood. Batman and Robin attempt to foil Marsha, Queen of Diamonds' plan to steal the Batcomputer's power source. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Marsha's Scheme of Diamonds. 1966. Stars Adam West, Carolyn Jones And Woody Strode. Marsha searches for a new potion to use on the Caped Crusaders in an attempt to obtain the Batcave's bat-diamond. [S]

programme.title: The Broken Melody
programme.desc: 1934. Directed by Bernard Vorhaus. Paul Verlaine, a struggling composer (John Garrick) is supported by Germaine (Merle Oberon) who is secretly in love with him. [S]

programme.title: The Mysterious Mr Nicholson
programme.desc: 1947. Crime drama. Directed by Oswald Mitchell and starring Anthony Hulme, Lesley Osmond and Frank Hawkins. A solicitors' clerk is sent to deliver a will and finds the recipient murdered. [S]

programme.title: Up The River
programme.desc: 1930. Comedy. Directed by John Ford. Stars Spencer Tracy, Claire Luce And Humphrey Bogart. When a paroled convict and former inmate are blackmailed, two career criminals come to their rescue. [S]

programme.title: Terror By Night
programme.desc: 1946. Crime Drama. Starring: Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce And Alan Mowbray. When a diamond is stolen on a train and the son of its owner is murdered, everybody is a suspect to Sherlock Holmes. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1956. Person Unknown. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, Edward Cast and Alan Robinson. A Polish spy changed places with a would-be assassin. (S1, E18)

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Spider. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips And Donald Pleasence. Austrian commander 'The Spider' captures two of Tell's men and threatens to torture them. Now Tell must infiltrate The Spider's ranks. [S]

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: 1955. Western. Directed by Tim Whelan. Stars Randolph Scott, Forrest Tucker And Mala Powers. A private detective from Chicago is sent out west to take down the notorious Reno brothers. [S]

programme.title: Out of the Fog
programme.desc: 1962. Crime drama directed by Montgomery Tully. An ex-con is the prime suspect when a series of murders occur under a full moon. Every victim is a blonde young woman. Starring David Sumner. [S]

programme.title: Daily Sketch Jigsaw Puzzle 1938
programme.desc: Take a nostalgic trip back to 1938 with this short film about the Daily Sketch's jigsaw puzzle.

programme.title: Storm Over the Nile
programme.desc: 1955. Directors: Zoltan Korda And Terence Young. Stars Anthony Steel And Laurence Harvey. A British officer is accused of cowardice by his friends and woman he loves. He sets out to prove his courage. [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Waverly Ring Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum And Larry Blyden. THRUSH has a mole inside New York headquarters. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to root out the double agent. [S]

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: A Point of Honour. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular And Gavin Richards. An encounter with a young lady on a train leads to a strange weekend of mistaken identity and danger. [S]

programme.title: An Englishman Abroad
programme.desc: 1983. Drama. Director: John Schlesinger. Stars Alan Bates, Coral Browne And Charles Gray. Based on a true story, actress Coral Browne has a chance meeting with a member of the Cambridge spy ring. [S]

programme.title: Run Wild, Run Free
programme.desc: 1969. Drama. Directed by Richard C. Sarafian. Stars John Mills, Sylvia Syms And Gordon Jackson. A psychosomatically mute young boy finds an emotional release through his love for a wild white colt. [S]

programme.title: Road Games
programme.desc: 1981. Thriller. Directed by Richard Franklin. Stars Jamie Lee Curtis, Stacy Keach And Marion Edward. A truck driver in Australia begins to suspect that a man is killing young women along his route. [S]

programme.title: The Big Lift
programme.desc: 1950. War drama starring Montgomery Clift. In 1948 the Soviet Union blockades the allied sectors of Berlin, to bring the entire city under their control. [S]

programme.title: Glimpses - Far Away Places
programme.desc: Parkside Productions present The Malcolm Mitchell Group playing 'Far Away Places'. Directed by Roger Proudlock.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Come Back, Shame. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward And Cliff Robertson. Batman and Robin reckon something's up when Shame steals Grimaldi Smith's hot racing car in the middle of the Gotham City 500. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: It's How You Play the Game. 1966. Stars Adam West, Cliff Robertson And Eric Shea. Shame goes to work on his final caper - the theft of four prize cattle worth over one million dollars. [S]

programme.title: Johnny On The Spot
programme.desc: 1954. Crime directed by Maclean Rogers. Johnny (Hugh McDermott) returns from a prison sentence to get the man who framed him. [S]

programme.title: Girdle of Gold
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy directed by Montgomery Tully and filmed at Nettlefold. Starring Esmond Knight and Maudie Edwards. A husband hides a fortune in his wife's girdle, only for the girdle to go 'missing'. [S]

programme.title: Hell's Angels
programme.desc: 1930. War. Director: Howard Hughes. Stars Ben Lyon, James Hall And Jean Harlow. Epic war film following the lives of two dissimilar brothers as they join the Royal Flying Corps when war breaks out. [S]

programme.title: Sussex Fortnight
programme.desc: Made in 1950. By bicycle with Raymond Glendenning to Arundel, Littlehampton and a horse show, ending with the Goodwood Cup.

programme.title: Night Train to Paris
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Douglas. Stars Leslie Nielsen And Aliza Gur. A retired spy agrees to a friend's request to deliver a tape to Paris and prevent it from falling into the wrong hands. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Instrument of War. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Andrew Keir And Charles Houston. Dan travels to Prisoner's Island to collect valuable cargo, however, the cargo is a single Scottish Highland Chief. [S]
